_contract: Approved stills to video (Omni 1.1 Flash, ingredients mode with approved still + HollowStickMike chip). 10s, 9:16 vertical, silent video. Two-phase kinetics (0-5s / 5-10s) with locked static cameras.

Locked-off static tripod camera. Completely silent video.
